dataset.generation: deterministic scenario-balanced synthetic Chinese writing-memory corpus
dataset.representativeScope: vertical writing-memory schema and language distribution; not production source text

caveats: This is a pinned-host, schema-aligned operational baseline, not a 50K-record capacity claim.
The corpus is deterministic synthetic data because the local MySQL instance contained no business novel or chapter rows at benchmark time.
Production capacity still requires a representative real corpus and the target deployment host specification.
Redis and RabbitMQ were available in the environment but are not on this repository's import critical path.
